intro: LockBit appears across five articles on third-party risk published between 13 April and 25 September 2026. The coverage spans healthcare, financial services, government, identity-management, and law-enforcement, with North America, Canada, and the United States named as the affected regions. Four of the five articles carry a high severity rating. The collection examines how dependencies on external vendors and partners expose organisations in these sectors and regions to disruption, and how those exposures intersect with LockBit activity during the six-month period.
